fact.subject: Microsoft
fact.object: Maia 300 架构与 2027 年扩容计划

evidence.quote: As we move into the era of Super Intelligence, Microsoft is entering a new phase of infrastructure. We will scale our Azure Maia family to multi-gigawatt deployments starting in 2027, making Maia the primary inference system for Microsoft products and services.

As AI workloads become increasingly context and memory-bound, Maia 300 delivers industry-leading HBM bandwidth per watt. Eight HBM4 stacks provide 18.0 TB/s of peak memory bandwidth within a 950-watt TDP, enabling efficient execution of large models and long-context workloads. Specialized kernel support uses on-die SRAM as a software-managed scratchpad, reducing pressure on HBM.
Maia 300 will begin production deployments in 2027. For more information on Maia 300 architectural details, read our

Maia 300 rack systems bring together 96 accelerators within a 167-kilowatt power envelope, delivering 27.6 TB of HBM capacity and 1.7 PB/s of aggregate HBM bandwidth across a high-speed scale-up domain.

title: Microsoft to expand Azure Maia system to multi-gigawatt deployments
displayTitle: 微软公布 Maia 300 架构，计划 2027 年扩至多吉瓦
entities: Maia 300 架构与 2027 年扩容计划
summary: 微软公布 Maia 300 推理系统与 2027 年开始的多吉瓦部署计划；Maia 200 已在生产工作负载中运行，Maia 300 采用八组 HBM4 与 96 加速器机架配置。
investorNote: 大规模自研推理芯片使云厂商能从单颗芯片优化到机架和供电，但性能与成本宣称仍待实际部署验证。
narrative: 微软披露 Maia 300 的推理架构，并计划从 2027 年起把 Azure Maia 扩至多吉瓦规模。八组 HBM4 的峰值带宽、96 卡机架和长上下文优化显示它针对代理推理的数据搬运瓶颈；这些是厂商给出的设计与规划，尚不是已交付规模或独立成本实测。

eventRelation.reason: 原文证实为本窗口内独立的新动作，历史目录未见相同发生
